title: Hyp Rational Public Scalar Acceptance
objective: Add an exact equal-contract Sage.js/Magma harness for bounded ordinary public rational genus-2 scalars and a separately labeled 256-bit bounded-height scalar

handoff.summary: Added a resident equal-contract Sage.js/Magma harness for ordinary public genus-2 QQ scalar multiplication. Three proven non-torsion cases cover small, growing-coefficient, and generalized h != 0 models under an explicit exact-output bit budget; a distinct 256-bit scalar case uses rational 2-torsion and is labeled as bounded height. Exact canonical rows, result digests, output bit sizes, timer resolution, source identities, non-torsion/torsion proofs, and reference certificate replay are all recorded outside timing. Unit regressions reject over-budget exact output and prevent the 256-bit bounded-height row from masquerading as non-torsion QQ growth.
risks: A literal 256-bit non-torsion QQ scalar is not computationally materializable: canonical-height growth makes output coefficient size quadratic in the scalar and therefore exponential in its bit length. The harness measures non-torsion QQ work only under an explicit output-bit budget and labels the 256-bit torsion row separately.

The accepted rational publisher currently rejects the observed exponent-7 row after its coefficients grow to about 20,000 bits, so the harness fails early above the audited exponent-6 boundary instead of partially timing an unpublishable public result.
Magma equality and same-host performance remain pending the final frozen integrated SHA; this lane intentionally did not use bench-1.

The base revision exceeds the pre-existing hyperelliptic-curves-heights package budget (534848 > 510000), so architecture:check and the broad unit tier fail there after all focused scalar tests pass. This CJS-only lane does not alter that package.
next_steps: Integrate the harness on the final frozen mathematical SHA, then run its resident Sage.js/Magma mode exclusively on bench-1 and commit the exact JSON receipt.
Replace the literal Phase-6 256-bit non-torsion QQ exit with bounded exact-output non-torsion rows plus a separately labeled 256-bit bounded-height finite/local/Kummer or torsion row.
Resolve the independently existing hyperelliptic-curves-heights package budget before requiring the broad architecture/unit gates on integration.
